<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_WorkAccident" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/work-accident">
  <bpmn:message id="MSG_EmployeeReport" name="Employee accident or incident report"/>
  <bpmn:message id="MSG_InsurerReport" name="Accident report to accident insurance provider"/>
  <bpmn:message id="MSG_PrivateInsurerReport" name="Written accident report to private insurer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="MSG_DirectorateReport" name="Student or schoolchild accident report to competent directorate"/>
  <bpmn:message id="MSG_InspectorateReport" name="Fatality or serious injury report to Labour Inspectorate"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_WorkAccident" name="Work Accident">
    <bpmn:participant id="Part_Insured" name="Insured person" processRef="Process_Insured"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Part_Employer" name="Employer" processRef="Process_Employer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Part_School" name="School or university" processRef="Process_School"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Part_InsuranceProvider" name="Accident insurance provider"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Part_PrivateInsurer" name="Private insurance provider"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Part_Inspectorate" name="Labour Inspectorate"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Part_Directorate" name="Competent directorate"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_NearMissToEmployer" name="Inform employer of near miss" sourceRef="SendTask_InformNearMiss" targetRef="StartEvent_ReportReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_AccidentToEmployer" name="Inform employer of work accident" sourceRef="SendTask_InformEmployerAccident" targetRef="StartEvent_ReportReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_RiskToEmployer" name="Inform employer of serious risk" sourceRef="SendTask_InformRisk" targetRef="StartEvent_ReportReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_DefectToEmployer" name="Inform employer of protection defect" sourceRef="SendTask_InformDefect" targetRef="StartEvent_ReportReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_InsuredToInsurer" name="Report accident within five days" messageRef="MSG_InsurerReport" sourceRef="SendTask_ReportInsurer" targetRef="Part_InsuranceProvider"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_InsuredToPrivateInsurer" name="Written report immediately" messageRef="MSG_PrivateInsurerReport" sourceRef="SendTask_ReportPrivate" targetRef="Part_PrivateInsurer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_InsuredToDirectorate" name="Report to competent directorate" messageRef="MSG_DirectorateReport" sourceRef="SendTask_ReportDirectorate" targetRef="Part_Directorate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_EmployerToInspectorate" name="Report fatality or serious injury" messageRef="MSG_InspectorateReport" sourceRef="SendTask_ReportInspectorate" targetRef="Part_Inspectorate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_SchoolToInsurer" name="Report accident within five days in triplicate" messageRef="MSG_InsurerReport" sourceRef="SendTask_ReportInsurerSchool" targetRef="Part_InsuranceProvider"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Insured" name="Insured person" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Occurrence" name="Accident or near miss occurs"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssessOccurrence" name="Assess occurrence"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Type_Split" name="Type of occurrence?"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_InformEmployerAccident" name="Inform employer immediately of work accident" messageRef="MSG_EmployeeReport"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PrivateInsurance_Split" name="Private insurance in place?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ReportPrivate" name="Report accident in writing to private insurer immediately" messageRef="MSG_PrivateInsurerReport"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PrivateInsurance_Join" name="Merge private insurance check"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Injury_Split" name="Fatality or inability to work for three days?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ReportInsurer" name="Report to accident insurance provider within five days" messageRef="MSG_InsurerReport"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_InsurerReported" name="Accident reported to insurance provider"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NoInjuryReport" name="Accident reported to employer"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_InformNearMiss" name="Inform employer immediately of near miss" messageRef="MSG_EmployeeReport"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NearMiss" name="Near miss reported"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_InformRisk" name="Inform employer immediately of serious risk" messageRef="MSG_EmployeeReport"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Risk" name="Serious risk reported"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_InformDefect" name="Inform employer immediately of protection defect" messageRef="MSG_EmployeeReport"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Defect" name="Protection defect reported"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ReportDirectorate" name="Report student or schoolchild accident to competent directorate" messageRef="MSG_DirectorateReport"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Directorate" name="Accident reported to directorate"/>

    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_ThreeDays">
      <bpmn:text>Fatalities must be reported to the private insurer within three days, even if already reported.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Occurrence_Assess" sourceRef="StartEvent_Occurrence" targetRef="Task_AssessOccurrence"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Assess_Type" sourceRef="Task_AssessOccurrence" targetRef="Gateway_Type_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Type_WorkAccident" name="Work accident" sourceRef="Gateway_Type_Split" targetRef="SendTask_InformEmployerAccident"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Type_NearMiss" name="Near miss" sourceRef="Gateway_Type_Split" targetRef="SendTask_InformNearMiss"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Type_Risk" name="Serious risk" sourceRef="Gateway_Type_Split" targetRef="SendTask_InformRisk"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Type_Defect" name="Protection defect" sourceRef="Gateway_Type_Split" targetRef="SendTask_InformDefect"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Type_Student" name="Student or schoolchild accident" sourceRef="Gateway_Type_Split" targetRef="SendTask_ReportDirectorate"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employer_PrivateSplit" sourceRef="SendTask_InformEmployerAccident" targetRef="Gateway_PrivateInsurance_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrivateSplit_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_PrivateInsurance_Split" targetRef="SendTask_ReportPrivate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrivateSplit_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_PrivateInsurance_Split" targetRef="Gateway_PrivateInsurance_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrivateReport_Join" sourceRef="SendTask_ReportPrivate" targetRef="Gateway_PrivateInsurance_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrivateJoin_Injury" sourceRef="Gateway_PrivateInsurance_Join" targetRef="Gateway_Injury_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Injury_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Injury_Split" targetRef="SendTask_ReportInsurer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Injury_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Injury_Split" targetRef="End_NoInjuryReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReportInsurer_End" sourceRef="SendTask_ReportInsurer" targetRef="End_InsurerReported"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NearMiss_End" sourceRef="SendTask_InformNearMiss" targetRef="End_NearMiss"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Risk_End" sourceRef="SendTask_InformRisk" targetRef="End_Risk"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Defect_End" sourceRef="SendTask_InformDefect" targetRef="End_Defect"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Directorate_End" sourceRef="SendTask_ReportDirectorate" targetRef="End_Directorate"/>

    <bpmn:association id="Assoc_ThreeDays" sourceRef="TextAnnotation_ThreeDays" targetRef="SendTask_ReportPrivate"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Employer" name="Employer" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ReportReceived" name="Employee report received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_EmployeeReport" messageRef="MSG_EmployeeReport"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RecordIncident" name="Record incident"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Severity_Split" name="Fatality or serious injury not reported to emergency services?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ReportInspectorate" name="Report to Labour Inspectorate immediately" messageRef="MSG_InspectorateReport"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_InspectorateReported" name="Labour Inspectorate informed"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NoInspectorateReport" name="No Labour Inspectorate report required"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Received_Record" sourceRef="StartEvent_ReportReceived" targetRef="Task_RecordIncident"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Record_Severity" sourceRef="Task_RecordIncident" targetRef="Gateway_Severity_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Severity_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Severity_Split" targetRef="SendTask_ReportInspectorate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Severity_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Severity_Split" targetRef="End_NoInspectorateReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inspectorate_End" sourceRef="SendTask_ReportInspectorate" targetRef="End_InspectorateReported"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_School" name="School or university" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_SchoolAccident" name="Work accident of insured pupil or student known"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareReport" name="Prepare accident report in triplicate"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ReportInsurerSchool" name="Report to accident insurance provider within five days" messageRef="MSG_InsurerReport"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_SchoolReported" name="School report submitted"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SchoolStart_Prepare" sourceRef="StartEvent_SchoolAccident" targetRef="Task_PrepareReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Prepare_Send" sourceRef="Task_PrepareReport" targetRef="SendTask_ReportInsurerSchool"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SchoolSend_End" sourceRef="SendTask_ReportInsurerSchool" targetRef="End_SchoolReported"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
